route_title: Dual-cavity bandpass filter with ZnS/MgF2 on Daimon-20 substrate
compilation_rationale: Bounded 22-layer stack compiled with fixed ZnS/MgF₂ alternation across mid-IR pass/stop bands. Quarter-wave initial thickness assumed near 1250 nm; bounds set to 0.5×–1.5× that value. Four mean-transmittance targets independently score all requested wavelength ranges without aggregation or relaxation.
